_comment: StrykerJS mutation-testing config (guardrails B7-3). Scoped tightly to the crypto and format byte/serialisation modules where mutation testing earns its cost. The command runner re-uses the existing fast/deterministic suites as the mutation oracle (the property tests plus the targeted crypto/format validators), so no extra test wiring is needed. Run with: npm run test:mutation

commandRunner.command: node test/property/property-crypto-format.ts && node test/property/property-primitives.ts && node test/validate-crypto.ts && node test/validate-canonnum.ts && node test/validate-format-prims.ts && node test/validate-reader.ts && node test/validate-ulid.ts && node test/validate-bytes.ts
